verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents issuing virtual cards (nominated or unnamed) as part of its own card-issuing platform, so the core 'create a virtual card' capability exists. However, nothing in the evidence shows a one-call API creation flow or programmatic access to PAN, CVV and expiry at issuance. Its onboarding is a formal integration project measured from a 'kickoff' (record 11 days to first live virtual-card transaction), which points to a managed onboarding process rather than self-serve sandbox-to-live. Missing for 10: evidence of a single API call for card creation, programmatic retrieval of PAN/CVV/expiry, self-serve promotion from sandbox to production without a sales or onboarding cycle, and independent corroboration.
